gaps.note: HIG section 10 tables the SYS/FAN/PS0/PS1/ID system lamps, the PSU and Fan FRU lamps and the management jack, and gives no table for the port lamps. The 48 led-arrow and 24 per-lane led-dot placements therefore keep their component default of off/on rather than an invented link/activity vocabulary. As on the S9510-28DC, these may be NOS-defined rather than undocumented; we do not know which.
gaps.wanted: a per-NOS LED table from UfiSpace or a NOS vendor, or photographs of a live unit with ports in known states

gaps.note: HIG section 8: 'there are two locations on the case in which the grounding lug may be fixed'. The rear-left two-hole location is photographed and modelled; Figure 23 shows the other only as an interior corner view with a yellow 'REMOVE LABEL FOR SYSTEM GROUNDING' sticker, which cannot be placed on a face from the figures held.
gaps.wanted: a photograph or drawing locating the second lug position on its face

gaps.note: Same finding the S9510-28DC records: the HIG dimensions and weighs the fan FRU (51.5 x 42.2 x 57.8 mm, 185 g) and tables its LED, and no UfiSpace document in the intake gives a wattage for it. The PSUs carry their 400 W rating from their own ordering lines.
gaps.wanted: a photograph of the fan module's label, or a UfiSpace FRU datasheet

gaps.note: No orderable chassis part number appears in the datasheet or HIG R1.8, so the orderable configurations carry no part-numbers map. The S9510-28DC's SKUs (S9510-28DC-BN0B/-BR1B) were supplied by the owner, not by its documents; equivalents likely exist for this box.
gaps.wanted: a UfiSpace ordering guide or a quote naming the DC and AC chassis SKUs

a `power-draw-max-w` on each module this chassis accepts, from the vendor's own per-card table - Cisco publishes one per ambient, most vendors publish none, and until they land a module total is a floor

a top-level `profile:` naming the device class, so that `specified` has something to judge the attrs against - see spec/schemas/profiles.yaml for the classes that exist, which unlocks `specified` and with it the About panel, and comparison against other devices
`physical-context` on 7 bays (rear 7); `physical-context` on port groups qsfp28, sfp28 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays
the Nautobot exporter is not importable - unlocks NetBox / Nautobot device-type export

provenance.bottom-face: estimated (no bottom photograph; compliance sticker centred per house pattern. A bottom view mirrors left-right; all content here is symmetric, recorded so the axis is known to have been considered)
provenance.chassis: datasheet (440 x 440 x 43.8 mm W x D x H, 1RU, 8.7 kg without FRU; HIG Space Clearance repeats 44.0 cm width and says the rack brackets suit 19-inch racks, so 440 is the body between the bolt-on ears, not a rack face)
provenance.colors: photo-measured medians (panel #2c2f32, ganged strips #b6b6b6, SFP number band #808041, QSFP number band #52663c, bezel plate #bdc1cf, label field #292929)
provenance.eol: searched 2026-08-28 ('UfiSpace S8901-54XC end of life') - no announcement; the product page is live at ufispace.com. Hence lifecycle eol none-announced.
provenance.front-layout: photo-measured (front render at 4.036 px/mm - SFP28 block A apertures 26.3 to 197.1, block B 200.4 to 371.4, QSFP28 columns at 375.6/ 394.7/413.7; all x positions read off aperture edges, then regularized to the standard 14.25 SFP and 19.05 QSFP pitches, which the render matches to 0.1 mm)
provenance.grounding: HIG section 8 and Figure 24 - the ground lug bolts to two M4 holes at the rear left, drawn as decor rings at x 6.9, y centres 7.2 and 23.2 (photo-measured), with the earth symbol below them at y 36.2. The HIG says there are TWO designated lug locations on the case; only this rear one is photographed, the second is registered in gaps.
provenance.led-positions: photo-measured (SYS/FAN/PS0/PS1 rect lamps at x centres 53.4/ 60.1/67.0/73.7, y centre 3.84, ID below PS1 at y 6.31 - RE-PITCHED in the model from the measured 6.8 mm to 7.7 mm, centres 52.5/60.2/67.9/75.6, because common/led-rect is 4.6 mm wide against the render's 2.7 mm lamp and the printed legends must land between the lamps; SFP arrow pairs on the ganged strip at y centre 22.64, up at column+4.9, down at column+8.5 centre; QSFP lane lamps 4 per port, above the block at y centre 7.55 for the top row and below the number band at 39.47 for the bottom row)
provenance.led-semantics: HIG section 10 page 21 Front Panel LED table, transcribed onto the lamps: SYS off/green boot complete/amber boot failed; FAN off/green all normal/blinking amber fan fail; PS0 and PS1 off/green/blinking amber, each tied to its own rear PSU bay; ID off/blinking blue beacon. The PSU FRU and Fan FRU tables live in the ufispace/psu-401-* and fan-402825 contracts. The management jack is declared per element from the Management Port LED table - left lamp green 1G link/activity, right lamp amber 10M/100M link/activity. The HIG gives NO table for the port lamps, so the 48 led-arrow and 24 led-dot placements keep their component off/on default; see gaps.
provenance.mgmt-stack: photo-measured centres, COMPRESSED TO FIT THE REUSED PARTS: the render's bezels are mgmt RJ45 6.5-18.5, USB 18.6-26.0, console 26.3-37.8 (31.3 mm total), while common/rj45-port@4 + common/usb-a@3 + common/rj45-bezel@2 stack to 39.1 mm. They are placed at y 1.6 / 16.9 / 26.4 - the USB lands on its measured centre, the two jacks are pulled up to 2.7 mm off theirs. The same trade the S9510-28DC made with the same three parts. THE TWO JACKS MIRROR - in a 10x crop the mgmt jack's pins are at the bottom and the console's at the top - and the mirroring is exactly the two components' defaults: rj45-port@4 composes std/rj45 rotated (pins down, LEDs top) while rj45-bezel@2 draws pins up, so NEITHER placement carries a rotate. A first draft rotated the console 180 and the render pass caught it.
provenance.part-numbers: vendor-silent in the intake - neither the datasheet nor HIG R1.8 prints an orderable chassis SKU (the S9510-28DC's SKUs came from the owner, not its documents; the same may exist here). FRU part numbers are real and belong to the FRU contracts: PSU-401-DESR/DISB-1/AESR/AISB and FAN-402825-HD/CD, from the datasheet's Available to Order section. The -E*/-H* suffixes are the exhaust (front-to-back, red latch) parts and -I*/-C* the intake (back-to-front, blue latch) parts, per the HIG's latch-colour convention.
provenance.power: datasheet 'Typical power: 120 Watts (no transceiver)' - the vendor's own scope, hence power-envelope: bare; HIG Connecting Power, both DC and AC sections: 'The maximum system power consumption is 396.5 watts'. The vendor does not say what population the maximum covers. AC 100-240V 6A, DC -36 to -75V 16A, both from the datasheet, 20A DC / 12A AC internal PSU fuses from the HIG.
provenance.qsfp-pitch: registry (TE 2322551 ganged pitch 19.0; photo-measured 19.07, modelled at 19.05 so three columns land on the measured aperture edges)
provenance.rear-layout: photo-measured as fractions (rear renders, blue-handle and red-handle variants agree): five fan handles at x centres 27.6/80.3/132.6/185.1/237.5 - a 52.5 mm bay pitch - with module seams at 14.9 and 66.5 fixing bay 0's left edge at 14.9; PSU latches (contract cx 2.4) at 323.8 and 383.6 putting the 50.5 mm PSU bays at 321.4 and 381.2 with the PSU0 legend on the 9.3 mm rib between them and PSU1's on the right edge. Fan bays at y 0.8 (42.2 in 43.8), PSUs at y 1.8 (40.2). Vendor art prints 'FAN ◀n' on each module face, not on the chassis - the fan component carries no numeral, so the numbering lives only in rel-pos; a chassis mark would be painted under the module.
provenance.rows: photo-measured (SFP aperture centres y 14.97 and 30.44 - a 15.5 mm row pitch, against the TE reference 15.0 belly-to-belly, which is not governed by any spec; QSFP centres 15.1 and 30.56)
provenance.sfp-pitch: registry (SFF-8433 14.25 mm; photo-measured 14.23-14.24 over 11 columns in each block, so the standard figure is used. The two 12-column blocks are separated by an extra 3.3 mm of panel)
provenance.side-faces: estimated (angle render s8901-54xc-1-view.png shows two rows of rivets along each side; ten drawn per side at estimated positions. AXIS: RIGHT view x = 0 is the FRONT, LEFT view x = 0 is the REAR, per viewer3d orientation)
provenance.silkscreen: photo (6x crops of the front render). Port numbering runs '▲ even odd ▼' per ganged column - even on top - printed dark on the olive-yellow band under the SFP blocks and light on the olive-green band under the QSFP block; wordmark S8901-54XC and RESET on the black label field; SYS/FAN/PS0/PS1/ID legends right of their lamps; the USB/arrows/console icon row printed at the panel foot is transcribed as 'SS⚡ ▲▼ IOIOI' and sits 2.5 mm lower than the render because the console jack component overruns the real bezel (see mgmt-stack). The OOB tree icon printed above the management jack is NOT drawn - the oversized jack stack leaves no panel between the plate and the top edge.
provenance.sources: datasheet (UfiSpace S8901-54XC Data Center ToR Switch, working/intake/ufispace/ converted/s8901-54xc-datasheet) for dimensions, port counts, silicon, power, environment and compliance; hardware installation guide R1.8 (s8901-54xc-hig) for FRU dimensions, LED tables, grounding and the system overview Figure 5; vendor product renders s8901-54xc-2-front.png (1776x177) and s8901-54xc-3/4-rear.png for layout measurement and colour. The front render's aspect is 10.034 against the datasheet's 440/43.8 = 10.046 - 0.1% out, so it was measured at 4.036 px/mm as an orthographic elevation. The rear renders are 9.86 - 1.8% out - so only x-fractions anchored on the 52.5 mm fan-handle pitch and the 51.5 mm fan module width were taken from them.
provenance.top-face: estimated (HIG Fig 5 top drawing, front at the drawing's top edge - four stiffening grooves and seven screw heads placed from its fractions anchored to the 440 x 440 datasheet footprint; the drawing is schematic so positions are estimated. AXIS: y = 0 is the REAR, per house convention)
